grh_691821b1a0c09a807ddd.title: Going Home
paragraphs: After Lydia Stevens is struck by a taxi in New York, she awakens in a hospital with no memory of the accident and is told she was lucky to survive. Back home, sculptor Alexander Pluto begins calling from the Cornwall farmhouse where Lydia spent childhood summers, claiming that her spirit appears there and insisting that she return. He eventually brings her to the eerily unchanged house, shows her a marble Persephone modeled on her, and reveals a childhood world that seems to exist around them. When Lydia finally remembers the crash, Alex says her return has been delayed since the accident; the closing narration strongly implies that Lydia actually died and has been drawn back to an afterlife shaped by her happiest childhood place.

[[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Anne Gibbon, Jack Kruschen, Vic Perrin, and Joan McCall. Other credited names include Fletcher Markle as director, Fletcher Markle as producer, Ann Heath as writer, and [[person|vincent-price|Vincent Price]] as host.
The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.9b0a0ccffce2f7d3|Sears, Roebuck and Company]].

grh_69578ed60abc5fe020b1.title: Crisis at Easter Creek
paragraphs: When Easter Creek's worn-out organ finally fails, Britt is pressured into raising the remaining money for a replacement. Ordinary townspeople have already given what they can, so Britt recruits reputed gunman Red Eye Kirk to accompany him among the rough characters living east of the creek, whose suddenly generous donations quickly cover the cost. The congregation hesitates to accept money associated with suspected outlaws, but Britt points out that the sheriff officially insists those men are law-abiding citizens. The organ is bought, and Red Eye and several of his friends even attend the Easter service to see how their contributions were used.

grh_69851f09351dd7bed32b.title: Corner Stone
paragraphs: Fourteen-year-old Freddie Clemons dreams of becoming an aviator and secretly spends time at the local airfield with pilot Alec Skinner, alarming parents who still treat him like a child.
